title: My Daughter Said Put My Old Dog Down or Lose Her Help. She Didn't Know Who That Dog Once Found.
description:
My daughter stood in my kitchen and told me to put my old dog Rosie down by Friday, or she would stop helping me. She called Rosie a smelly old burden. She had no idea what that dog did one winter night, or who would be waiting at the fire hall.

Stay until Hometown Heroes night. That's when an old dog walked up on stage.
